senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; fem. of פֶּלֶא)hidden thing, secret; miracle. Y. Ḥag. III, 77ᶜ top (fr. Ben Sira) פ׳ ממך מה תדע why wilt thou attempt to know what is hidden from thee? (v. מוּפְלָא).
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 18</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 139:6">Ps. CXXXIX, 6</cite>) <he>פ׳ זו התוֹרה</he> ‘the secret’, that means the Law.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:5">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Q00931"><he>פלאי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Judges 13:18">Jud. XIII, 18</cite>) <he>לפי פ׳ ופ׳ וכ׳</he> according to each miracle that he (the Lord) performs through us (angels), he names us.
